instruction: Look at rect_pocket_block.step in SOLIDWORKS with the SOLIDWORKS CAM add-in. Before starting the work, start SOLIDWORKS 2025 from the desktop shortcut and use its installed SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks add-in; there is no separate SolidCAM desktop program in this image. Create a standard 2.5D Pocket operation for rect_pocket_block.step. Machine the centered 50 x 30 pocket to bottom Z=8.000 mm, use maximum stepdown 2 mm, leave 0.1 mm floor stock, and add a bottom finish pass. Use the standard Pocket operation and keep SOLIDWORKS CAM's default generated NC comments; do not rename operations just to add labels. Do not force exact tool station numbers, spindle speeds, feedrates, or internal tool-library IDs if SOLIDWORKS CAM's Technology Database assigns stable defaults; use suitable installed tool-library entries for the required operation types and let the posted NC program reflect those real CAM selections. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-4.nc. Generate the required NC/G-code file(s) by using SOLIDWORKS CAM's normal Post Process workflow after calculating the toolpath, with an installed .ctl postprocessor from C:\ProgramData\SOLIDWORKS\SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025\Posts. For milling tasks, prefer m3axis-tutorial.ctl, mach_iii.ctl, or haas_vf3.ctl; for turning tasks, use an installed turning .ctl post such as fanuc_t2axis.ctl. If the generated program opens in NC Editor or is initially saved with a different extension, use Save As from that generated program to save the exact requested Desktop filename(s).
